---
title: "Collaborators"
---

A map of coauthorship connections. Nodes are colored by the main research area of the corresponding collaborations. Node sizes reflect the number of papers and the recency of the collaborations. 

<div id="legend"></div>
<div id="collab-network"></div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7"></script>
<script src="papers.js"></script>

<script>
const width = 1150;
const height = 1000;

const mainAuthor = "H. Oliveri";

const topicInfo = {
  plants: {
    label: "Plant mechanics and morphogenesis",
    color: "#009E73"   // bluish green
  },
  neuro: {
    label: "Neuronal growth and durotaxis",
    color: "#CC79A7"   // reddish purple
  },
  transport: {
    label: "Biological transport and networks",
    color: "#0072B2"   // blue
  },
  mechanics: {
    label: "Nonlinear mechanics",
    color: "#E69F00"   // orange
  },
  biomechanics: {
    label: "Biomechanics and surgery",
    color: "#D55E00"   // vermillion
  },
  mixed: {
    label: "Mixed collaborations",
    color: "#999999"   // grey
  },
   me: {
     label: "Hadrien Oliveri",
     color: "#000000"   // black
   }
};

// --------------------------------------------------
// Build nodes and coauthor links from papers.js
// --------------------------------------------------

const nodeMap = new Map();
const edgeMap = new Map();

function ensureNode(author) {
  if (!nodeMap.has(author)) {
    nodeMap.set(author, {
      id: author,
      papers: 0,
      topics: {},
      size: 10,
      group: "mixed"
    });
  }

  return nodeMap.get(author);
}

function edgeKey(a, b) {
  return [a, b].sort().join("|||");
}

papers.forEach(paper => {
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
const tau = 3; // larger = older collaborations remain important longer

papers.forEach(paper => {
  const age = currentYear - paper.year;
  const timeWeight = Math.exp(-age / tau);

  paper.authors.forEach(author => {
    const node = ensureNode(author);

    // raw paper count
    node.papers += 1;

    // time-weighted collaboration score
    node.weightedPapers = (node.weightedPapers || 0) + timeWeight;

    if (paper.topic) {
      node.topics[paper.topic] = (node.topics[paper.topic] || 0) + timeWeight;
    }
  });

  // Connect every pair of coauthors on the same paper
  for (let i = 0; i < paper.authors.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < paper.authors.length; j++) {
      const a = paper.authors[i];
      const b = paper.authors[j];
      const key = edgeKey(a, b);

      if (!edgeMap.has(key)) {
        edgeMap.set(key, {
          source: a,
          target: b,
          value: 0,
          papers: []
        });
      }

      const edge = edgeMap.get(key);
      edge.value += .1 * timeWeight;
      edge.papers.push(paper.title);
    }
  }
});

  // Connect every pair of coauthors on the same paper
  for (let i = 0; i < paper.authors.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < paper.authors.length; j++) {
      const a = paper.authors[i];
      const b = paper.authors[j];
      const key = edgeKey(a, b);

      if (!edgeMap.has(key)) {
        edgeMap.set(key, {
          source: a,
          target: b,
          value: 0,
          papers: []
        });
      }

      const edge = edgeMap.get(key);
      edge.value += .05;
      edge.papers.push(paper.title);
    }
  }
});

const nodes = Array.from(nodeMap.values());
const links = Array.from(edgeMap.values());

// --------------------------------------------------
// Assign dominant topic and logarithmic bubble size
// --------------------------------------------------

nodes.forEach(node => {
  if (node.id === mainAuthor) {
    node.group = "me";
    node.size = 28;
    return;
  }

  const topics = Object.entries(node.topics).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  node.group = topics.length ? topics[0][0] : "mixed";

  // Logarithmic scaling to emphasize frequent collaborators
  node.size =  10 * Math.log1p(.15 * node.weightedPapers || 0);

});

// --------------------------------------------------
// Legend
// --------------------------------------------------

const legendItems = Object.entries(topicInfo)
  .filter(([key]) => key !== "mixed" && key !== "me");

const legend = d3.select("#legend")
  .append("div")
  .attr("class", "network-legend");

legendItems.forEach(([key, info]) => {
  const item = legend.append("div")
    .attr("class", "legend-item");

  item.append("span")
    .attr("class", "legend-dot")
    .style("background", info.color);

  item.append("span")
    .text(info.label);
});

// --------------------------------------------------
// SVG
// --------------------------------------------------

const svg = d3.select("#collab-network")
  .append("svg")
  .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)
  .attr("width", "100%")
  .attr("height", "auto");

  const defs = svg.append("defs");

// Soft shadow for nodes
const nodeShadow = defs.append("filter")
  .attr("id", "node-shadow")
  .attr("x", "-50%")
  .attr("y", "-50%")
  .attr("width", "200%")
  .attr("height", "200%");

const specularBlur = defs.append("filter")
  .attr("id", "specular-blur")
  .attr("x", "-50%")
  .attr("y", "-50%")
  .attr("width", "200%")
  .attr("height", "200%");

specularBlur.append("feGaussianBlur")
  .attr("stdDeviation", 2.2);

nodeShadow.append("feDropShadow")
  .attr("dx", 0)
  .attr("dy", 1.2)
  .attr("stdDeviation", 1.2)
  .attr("flood-color", "#000000")
  .attr("flood-opacity", 0.18);

// Gentle edge gradient
const edgeGradient = defs.append("linearGradient")
  .attr("id", "edge-gradient")
  .attr("gradientUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");

edgeGradient.append("stop")
  .attr("offset", "0%")
  .attr("stop-color", "#d3d3d3");

edgeGradient.append("stop")
  .attr("offset", "100%")
  .attr("stop-color", "#8d8d8d");

// Explicit layer order
const linkLayer = svg.append("g").attr("class", "links");
const nodeLayer = svg.append("g").attr("class", "nodes");
const labelLayer = svg.append("g").attr("class", "labels");

// --------------------------------------------------
// Draw straight edges first, behind bubbles
// --------------------------------------------------

const link = linkLayer
  .selectAll("line")
  .data(links)
  .join("line")
  .attr("stroke", "url(#edge-gradient)")
  .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.5)
  .attr("stroke-width", d => 0. + Math.sqrt(d.value))
  .attr("stroke-linecap", "round");

link.append("title")
  .text(d => {
    const source = typeof d.source === "object" ? d.source.id : d.source;
    const target = typeof d.target === "object" ? d.target.id : d.target;

    return `${source} ↔ ${target}\n${d.value} shared paper(s)\n\n${d.papers.join("\n")}`;
  });

// --------------------------------------------------
// Draw bubbles second, in front of edges
// --------------------------------------------------

const node = nodeLayer
  .selectAll("g")
  .data(nodes)
  .join("g")
  .attr("filter", "url(#node-shadow)")
  .call(drag());

const pie = d3.pie()
  .value(d => d[1])
  .sort(null);

node.each(function(d) {
  const g = d3.select(this);
  const topics = Object.entries(d.topics);

  // Main author stays solid
  if (d.id === mainAuthor || topics.length === 0) {
    g.append("circle")
      .attr("r", d.size)
      .attr("fill", topicInfo[d.group]?.color || topicInfo.mixed.color)
      .attr("stroke", "#111111")
      .attr("stroke-width", d.id === mainAuthor ? 1.8 : 0.9);

    // subtle highlight
    g.append("ellipse")
    .attr("cx", -0.1 * d.size)
    .attr("cy", -0.5 * d.size)
    .attr("rx", 0.3 * d.size)
    .attr("ry", 0.26 * d.size)
    .attr("fill", "#ffffff")
    .attr("filter", "url(#specular-blur)")
    .attr("opacity", 0.16)
    
    .attr("transform", "rotate(-20)");

    return;
  }

  const arc = d3.arc()
    .innerRadius(0)
    .outerRadius(d.size);

  g.selectAll("path")
    .data(pie(topics))
    .join("path")
    .attr("d", arc)
    .attr("fill", slice => topicInfo[slice.data[0]]?.color || topicInfo.mixed.color)
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)")
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.7);

  // outer border
  g.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d.size)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(0,0,0,0.65)")
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.9);

  // subtle highlight / shine
  g.append("ellipse")
    .attr("cx", -0.1 * d.size)
    .attr("cy", -0.5 * d.size)
    .attr("rx", 0.3 * d.size)
    .attr("ry", 0.26 * d.size)
    .attr("fill", "#ffffff")
    .attr("filter", "url(#specular-blur)")
    .attr("opacity", 0.16)
    .attr("transform", "rotate(-20)");
});

node.append("title")
  .text(d => {
    const topicText = Object.entries(d.topics)
      .map(([topic, count]) => `${topicInfo[topic]?.label || topic}: ${count}`)
      .join("\n");

    return `${d.id}\n${d.papers} paper(s)\n${topicText}`;
  });

// --------------------------------------------------
// Draw labels last
// --------------------------------------------------

const label = labelLayer
  .selectAll("text")
  .data(nodes)
  .join("text")
  .text(d => d.id)
  .attr("font-size", d => d.id === mainAuthor ? 15 : 11.5)
  .attr("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
  .attr("font-weight", d => d.id === mainAuthor ? 700 : 400)
  .attr("fill", "#111111")
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .attr("dy", d => d.size + 15)
  .style("pointer-events", "none");

// Force layer order explicitly
linkLayer.lower();
nodeLayer.raise();
labelLayer.raise();

// --------------------------------------------------
// Force simulation
// --------------------------------------------------
function boundaryForce(padding = 90, strength = 0.08) {
  let nodes;

  function force() {
    for (const d of nodes) {
      if (d.x < padding) {
        d.vx += (padding - d.x) * strength;
      }
      if (d.x > width - padding) {
        d.vx += (width - padding - d.x) * strength;
      }
      if (d.y < padding) {
        d.vy += (padding - d.y) * strength;
      }
      if (d.y > height - padding) {
        d.vy += (height - padding - d.y) * strength;
      }
    }
  }

  force.initialize = function(_) {
    nodes = _;
  };

  return force;
}
const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
  .force("link", d3.forceLink(links)
    .id(d => d.id)
    .distance(d => 95 + 8 * d.value)
    .strength(0.18)
  )
  .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-750))
  .force("center", d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
  .force("collision", d3.forceCollide().radius(d => d.size + 28))
  .force("boundary", boundaryForce(130, 0.08))
  .force("x", d3.forceX(d => {
    if (d.group === "plants") return width * 0.28;
    if (d.group === "neuro") return width * 0.72;
    if (d.group === "transport") return width * 0.68;
    if (d.group === "biomechanics") return width * 0.25;
    if (d.group === "mechanics") return width * 0.50;
    return width * 0.50;
  }).strength(0.035))
  .force("y", d3.forceY(d => {
  if (d.group === "plants") return height * 0.34;
  if (d.group === "neuro") return height * 0.36;
  if (d.group === "transport") return height * 0.67;
  if (d.group === "biomechanics") return height * 0.70;
  if (d.group === "mechanics") return height * 0.50;
  return height * 0.52;
}).strength(0.035))

// --------------------------------------------------
// Tick update: straight edges
// --------------------------------------------------
simulation.on("tick", () => {
  const padding = 100;

  nodes.forEach(d => {
    d.x = Math.max(padding, Math.min(width - padding, d.x));
    d.y = Math.max(padding, Math.min(height - padding, d.y));
  });

  link
    .attr("x1", d => d.source.x)
    .attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
    .attr("x2", d => d.target.x)
    .attr("y2", d => d.target.y);

  node
  .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`);

  label
    .attr("x", d => d.x)
    .attr("y", d => d.y);
});

// --------------------------------------------------
// Drag behavior
// --------------------------------------------------

function drag() {
  function dragstarted(event, d) {
    if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.15).restart();
    d.fx = d.x;
    d.fy = d.y;
  }

  function dragged(event, d) {
    d.fx = event.x;
    d.fy = event.y;
  }

  function dragended(event, d) {
    if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
    d.fx = null;
    d.fy = null;
  }

  return d3.drag()
    .on("start", dragstarted)
    .on("drag", dragged)
    .on("end", dragended);
}
</script>
